sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list K2-122 and K2-122B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 663843343706623232 and 663843446785837952), 1,452 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 5.2e-6: the pair is bound.
